orientationRules.rule: Orient the longest walls of the structure facing true South (in Northern hemisphere) or true North (in Southern hemisphere).
orientationRules.benefit: Maximizes passive heating in Winter, reduces heat load in Summer.

orientationRules.rule: Place 70-80% of window glazing on the solar-facing wall. Keep window sizes minimal on East/West/North walls.
orientationRules.benefit: Allows high winter solar heat gain while preventing severe overnight heat loss.

orientationRules.rule: Calculate roof overhangs using the local latitude angle. Overhangs must shade windows in summer while letting winter sun pass underneath.
orientationRules.benefit: Prevents building overheating during the summer solstice.

insulationOptions.pros: Natural, absorbs moisture without losing R-value, filters air pollutants.

insulationOptions.cons: Releases glass fibers, loses R-value if wet, itchy to install.

insulationOptions.rValue: R-2.4 to R-3.0 per inch (total R-35+ for typical wall)
insulationOptions.pros: Superb insulation, highly renewable, carbon-sequestering, low-cost.
insulationOptions.cons: Thick walls require wide foundations, highly vulnerable to water rot during construction.
